simple.meaning: נָקָם (nâqâm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “revenge.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 17 times across Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, Psalms, Proverbs, and 3 more, beginning at Leviticus 26:25. Its contexts include family line, righteousness, covenant.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָקָם (H5359).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָקָם (nâqâm) / H5359 is traced through Leviticus 26:25, Deuteronomy 32:35, Deuteronomy 32:41, Deuteronomy 32:43 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

definitions.full: H5359. naqam נָקָם noun masculine vengeance ; — ׳נ Deut 32:35 14 t.; construct נְקַם Lev 26:25 ; Judg 16:28 ; — 1 taken by God, absolute Ezek 24:8 ; Psa 58:11 ; ׳נ בְּדִית vengeance of the covenant Lev 26:25 (H); נקם יוֺם Isa 34:8 ; 61:2 ; 63:4 ; נ ׳בִּגְדֵי 59:17 ; וְשִׁלֵּם נָקָם לִי Deut 32:35 ; נ ׳לקח Isa 47:3 ; ׳נ יבוא 35:4 ; with accusative adversary נ ׳עשׂה Micah 5:14 ; with לְ of adversary נ ׳חשׁיב Deut 32:41 , 43 . 2 Samson against Philistines , נ ׳נקם Judg 16:28 . 3 enemies against Judah, absolute Ezek 25:12 , 15 ; individual enemy נ ׳יום Prov 6:34 .
